Guidance Bends the Trajectory.zh: 引导机制使轨迹发生弯折

A diffusion model generates by starting.zh:
扩散模型从纯噪声出发，运行一个习得的 @@T0@@反向@@T1@@ 过程，
      将每个样本逐步带回数据分布，从而完成生成。若不加干预，它是
      @@T2@@无条件的@@T3@@ — 样本散布于各个众数之上。加入一个
      指向所选类别的 @@T4@@引导@@T5@@ 项，轨迹便会朝其弯折。
      将旋钮调大，弯折愈发强烈…并最终坍缩到该类别的中心。保真度
      上升，多样性下降。请在下方观察这一过程。
A diffusion model generates by starting.src: A diffusion model generates by starting from pure noise and running a learned reverse process that walks each sample back toward the data. Left alone it is unconditional — samples scatter across every mode. Add a guidance term pointing at a chosen class and the trajectories bend toward it. Turn the knob up and they bend harder… and collapse onto the class's centre. Fidelity up, diversity down. Watch it happen below.

@@T0@@~9 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.zh:
@@T0@@约 9 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 扩散模型 · 条件生成@@T3@@
@@T0@@~9 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.src: ~9 min Deep Learning · Diffusion Models · Conditional Generation

The reverse process moves a sample $x$ i.zh:
反向过程将样本 $x$ 沿 @@T0@@分数@@T1@@ $\nabla_x \log p(x)$ 的方向
      移动 — 即朝概率上升的方向 — 同时缓慢地去除噪声。这一
      无条件分数将每个样本拉向离它最近的数据众数，因此一个批次最终会
      散布在 @@T2@@所有@@T3@@ 众数之上。
The reverse process moves a sample $x$ i.src: The reverse process moves a sample $x$ in the direction of the score $\nabla_x \log p(x)$ — uphill in probability — while slowly removing noise. That unconditional score pulls each sample toward whichever data mode is nearest, so a batch ends up spread over all the modes.

To condition on a class $c$ we want the.zh:
要以类别 $c$ 为条件，我们需要 $p(x \mid c)$ 的分数。Bayes 法则
      将其拆分为无条件分数加上一个分类器的梯度，而引导机制只是
      用一个尺度 $w$ 对第二项 @@T0@@加权放大@@T1@@：
To condition on a class $c$ we want the.src: To condition on a class $c$ we want the score of $p(x \mid c)$. Bayes' rule splits it into the unconditional score plus the gradient of a classifier, and guidance simply over-weights that second term by a scale $w$:

At $w = 0$ the class term vanishes and y.zh:
当 $w = 0$ 时，类别项消失，你便进行无条件采样。随着 $w$ 增大，
      朝类别 $c$ 的牵引逐渐占据主导 — 无论是有分类器引导还是无分类器
      引导，其机制皆在于此。
At $w = 0$ the class term vanishes and y.src:
At $w = 0$ the class term vanishes and you sample unconditionally. As $w$ grows the pull
      toward class $c$ dominates — the mechanism behind classifier and classifier-free
      guidance alike.

Turn the knob, watch the pull.src: Turn the knob, watch the pull

Three class blobs sit in the plane (the.zh:
平面中有三个类别簇（即数据分布）。按 @@T0@@运行@@T1@@，
      一批带噪样本便运行反向过程，留下浅淡的轨迹。在
      @@T2@@引导 $w = 0$@@T3@@ 时，它们散布在全部三个簇上。提高
      @@T4@@引导尺度@@T5@@ 并选定一个 @@T6@@目标类别@@T7@@：轨迹便会朝
      该簇弯折。将 $w$ 推至很大时，它们堆积到该簇中心 — 清晰、属于该类，且
      彼此几乎相同。
Three class blobs sit in the plane (the.src: Three class blobs sit in the plane (the data distribution). Press Run and a batch of noisy samples runs the reverse process, leaving faint trails. With guidance $w = 0$ they settle across all three blobs. Raise the guidance scale and pick a target class: the trajectories bend toward that blob. Push $w$ high and they pile onto its centre — sharp, on-class, and nearly identical.

Large rings are the three class blobs; t.zh:
大方环代表三个类别簇；被选中的那个以高亮显示。圆点为样本；
        浅色线条是它们从噪声到数据的反向扩散轨迹。改变 $w$ 或
        目标类别，然后按 @@T0@@运行@@T1@@ 重新采样。

@@T0@@Sweep $w$ from 0 upward and re-run.zh:
@@T0@@将 $w$ 从 0 起逐步调高并重新运行。@@T1@@ 观察这两个数值朝相反
      方向变化：保真度（落在目标类别上的比例）上升，而多样性（样本的分散
      程度）下降。这种取舍正是引导机制的标志 — 不存在
      同时使二者最大化的设定。
@@T0@@Sweep $w$ from 0 upward and re-run.src: Sweep $w$ from 0 upward and re-run. Watch the two numbers move in opposite directions: fidelity (fraction landing on the target class) climbs while diversity (how spread out the samples are) falls. That trade is the signature of guidance — there is no setting that maximizes both.

Fidelity and diversity pull against each.zh: 保真度与多样性彼此相抗
Fidelity and diversity pull against each.src: Fidelity and diversity pull against each other

Guidance re-weights the sampling distrib.zh:
引导机制将采样分布重新加权为大致 $p(x)\,p(c\mid x)^{w}$。指数越大，
      类别后验越尖锐：概率质量集中到分类器最有把握之处 —
      即目标簇的中心。这正是 @@T0@@保真度@@T1@@ 所需要的
      （样本毫无疑问地属于该类别），也恰好是摧毁
      @@T2@@多样性@@T3@@ 的原因（尾部与相邻众数被剥夺了概率质量）。
Guidance re-weights the sampling distrib.src: Guidance re-weights the sampling distribution toward roughly $p(x)\,p(c\mid x)^{w}$. A larger exponent sharpens the class posterior: probability mass concentrates where the classifier is most confident — the centre of the target blob. That is exactly what you want for fidelity (samples unmistakably belong to the class) and exactly what destroys diversity (the tails and neighbouring modes get starved).

@@T0@@$w = 0$:@@T1@@ pure unconditional.zh: @@T0@@$w = 0$：@@T1@@ 纯无条件采样 — 每个众数都有体现，多样性最大，但无法控制。
@@T0@@$w = 0$:@@T1@@ pure unconditional.src: $w = 0$: pure unconditional sampling — every mode represented, maximal variety, no control.

@@T0@@Moderate $w$:@@T1@@ the sweet spot.zh: @@T0@@中等 $w$：@@T1@@ 最佳区间 — 明确属于目标类别，同时仍具多样性。真实系统使用个位数的小尺度。
@@T0@@Moderate $w$:@@T1@@ the sweet spot.src: Moderate $w$: the sweet spot — clearly on-class while still varied. Real systems use small single-digit scales.

@@T0@@Large $w$:@@T1@@ mode collapse &md.zh: @@T0@@很大的 $w$：@@T1@@ 众数坍缩 — 样本过度饱和、几乎完全相同，且聚集在类别中心。
@@T0@@Large $w$:@@T1@@ mode collapse &md.src: Large $w$: mode collapse — oversaturated, near-identical samples clustered at the class centre.

@@T0@@Classifier-free guidance.@@T1@@ Ra.zh:
@@T0@@无分类器引导。@@T1@@ 现代系统并不单独训练一个带噪图像分类器，
      而是训练单一网络同时预测条件分数与无条件分数（通过
      随机丢弃标签实现）。采样时它们作如下外推
      $\tilde{\varepsilon} = (1{+}w)\,\varepsilon_c - w\,\varepsilon_{\varnothing}$，从而在无需额外分类器的情况下
      得到同样的弯折轨迹。同一个旋钮，同样的取舍 — 这正是你在 Stable Diffusion 或
      Imagen 中设定的引导尺度。
@@T0@@Classifier-free guidance.@@T1@@ Ra.src: Classifier-free guidance. Rather than train a separate noisy-image classifier, modern systems train one network to predict both the conditional and unconditional score (by randomly dropping the label). At sampling time they extrapolate $\tilde{\varepsilon} = (1{+}w)\,\varepsilon_c - w\,\varepsilon_{\varnothing}$, reaching the same bent trajectories with no extra classifier. Same knob, same trade-off — this is the guidance scale you set in Stable Diffusion or Imagen.

meta.title: 引导机制使轨迹发生弯折
meta.tagline: 引导机制将扩散采样导向某一类别 — 并以多样性换取保真度
meta.summary: 扩散模型通过运行一个习得的反向过程，将噪声逐步带回数据分布，从而实现采样。在无条件情形下，样本散布于各个众数之上。引导项加入一股朝向所选类别的牵引，并由尺度 w 加权放大：当 w=0 时轨迹散布于所有众数之上，随着 w 增大，它们强烈弯折向目标类别，却坍缩到该类别中心。选定目标，扫描引导尺度，按运行，观察反向轨迹如何动态演化，而保真度与多样性两个数值朝相反方向变化。
highlights: 观察一段动画化的反向扩散过程，将一批带噪样本逐步带回三个数据众数。
将引导尺度从 0（无条件，所有众数）向上调节，观察轨迹朝所选类别弯折。
将尺度推高，观察样本坍缩到目标类别中心 — 众数坍缩的实例。
随着引导旋钮的转动，观察保真度与多样性两个数值朝相反方向变化。
将这一玩具模型与真实系统联系起来：同一个旋钮就是 Stable Diffusion 与 Imagen 中的无分类器引导。
